summary: Nuxt page component for the desktop route `lang-company-archive` (layout `empty`), the company archive/history page. In `asyncData` it calls the CMS content API (module 1118) `getKrHistory`, which fetches the `/getContentList` entry for channel `CHANNEL_ID_CONFIG.PROTOCOL.HISTORY`, passing `sLangKey: store.state.lang`; when nothing is returned it redirects to `lang-main` (with `params.lang = store.state.lang`), otherwise it exposes `title` and `content` (from `sTitle`/`sContent`) as page data. `head()` sets the document title to the entry title plus the i18n `seoTitlePrefix`. The render function shows the `protocol` text component (desktop protocol, module 1142) with `title`/`content` inside `client-only`.

exports.default: the `lang-company-archive` desktop company archive/history page Vue component (compiled with vue-loader normalizer)
